notes.title: Enforcer: Police Crime Action is a full-blooded police simulator. Yet it's hilarious
notes.content:
Enforcer: Police Crime Action puts you behind the badge of a Mountain Valley Police Officer. It's your duty to keep the peace, be that by setting up roadblocks to check for drunk drivers, ticketing illegally parked cars, or hunting down escaped murderers in the woods.

Too few games let you play as the police and, when they do, it's often as an undercover cop so you end up committing crimes anyway. Enforcer's not like that. It's an authentic police simulator and it allows for a lot more fun than you'd expect.

I just wasn't expecting people to fly into the air when I tased them.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Flashing Lights - Online Multiplayer Police, Fire and EMS
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

As many of you may know, Enforcer has not received any updates for quite some time. Odin Game Studios, the development team that worked on Enforcer has since been closed permanently and the team has split up and began working on other titles. Unfortunately, this means that there will be no more updates to Enforcer as the developer has shut down.

Since Enforcer, as a publisher we have been working on games like Jalopy, Dad Quest, Shoppe Keep, Floatlands and Tracks: The Train Set Game. These are of course titles that probably don’t interest many of you here, but since publishing Enforcer we’ve learnt a lot and have evolved to try and do the best we can.

We have been working on a new game for several months with a new developer that has no relationship with Odin Game Studios. which combines Police, Fire and Emergency Medical Services with online multiplayer. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6782801/86b41c4cb6cff6769a1d24876823a480409aff2c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6782801/3b6ddc2fb3a41c47e40add99d67ea87c05f81ac2.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6782801/7326c567a94cf4954d962495ad552499718cc93a.png[/img]

This project is being developed by a new developer and can be played co-operatively online with up to six players on a 7km x 7km map (Though the number of players that can play together may increase over time). 

Details of the development will be much more transparent and we will not be talking about any content in detail until it is working as a functioning prototype. This is how we’ve been handling all updates for all our titles. The biggest mistake we learnt from Enforcer was communicating an update from the developer before seeing it for ourselves.  This is what led to the current mess with Enforcer and we have been doing everything we can across all other games to avoid mentioning what is coming until we see it working ourselves.

We have launched a Kickstarter campaign for Flashing Lights which will include access to the games Alpha towards the end of this year. All Pledges (except the £1 pledge) contains alpha access because we need feedback. I have a large list of suggestions, features and dislikes collected from the Enforcer forum and we’re working through those. But being able to share builds and receive feedback will be invaluable to the game. 

If you want to check out the game in more detail, do check out the games Kickstarter Page. 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/excaliburgames/flashing-lights-police-fire-ems

notes.title: Enforcer - Reverting To Old Build + Preview forum + Public QA sheet
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we are aware of some issues that were introduced in the last build. We are awaiting a new fix to these issues over the next day or two. However I’ve decided to roll back the default build before the latest update. 

What I have done is create a new branch which players can access to see the current work on the update.  To access this, you will need to go into your steam library, click properties, click beta and then enter the following code

enforcerpreview

Alongside this I have made a public Google QA report which will update with issues from the community. Currently the issues are predominately to do with the driving mechanics that were introduced.  Though I will populate it with more details in the following weeks.

You can view the list here:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1G4UmULqprCmbSBzO3FjQ1veWh8EqlZJYsDsXmuFoaGQ/edit?usp=sharing

Currently Odin are uploading a build with the issues in green addressed. When this has been done, I will update the preview branch on Steam and will await any feedback from the community. I have created a special preview branch on  the forums where I will visit this and update the google QA report so Odin have information on how to replicate issues etc. If you want to report an issue, the more info you have to share, the better it will be for us to fix this.

http://steamcommunity.com/app/318220/discussions/6/
Odin are preparing another update this week, it will go straight into the preview build. When it is ready to go live I will make it public.

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: INCOMING UPDATE
notes.content:
We are still working on the update, for more info about the delay please access the link bellow:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/318220/discussions/0/541906989405099673/#c523897277917950923

UPDATE: 24th June:  Hi everyone. We will have to delay the release of this update to July. This is quite a big undertaking and the developer needs just a little more time to get everything in place. I'm hoping that we can release mid July and I will keep you informed with the details.

I will also be considering a beta development branch so those who are interested in seeing it (Although not in a polished state) may be able to check it out earlier before we roll it out to everyone.

All the best,
Chris

ORIGINAL POST:

Hello everyone.
 
We have some exciting news for the next update for Enforcer. The update is planned to launch by the end of June and will include quite a selection of new features and refinements. 
 
[h1][b]New Game Mode: Sandbox[/b][/h1]
The Sandbox mode will behave differently than career mode. You will always be on duty and some of the stamina/hunger systems will change slightly. You will receive money over time as a salary. Along with this, we will have a few new additions in this mode:
 
[list]
[*]A new map exclusive to sandbox mode
[*]More missions exclusive to sandbox mode
[*]Different buildings
[/list]
 
Along with this new mode/map we will also include:
 
[list]
[*]Improved vehicle handling
[*]Increased difficulty of Hardcore mode
[/list]
 
We do have a selection of possible refinements, but this is of course due to time. I will mention these only so to keep everyone in the loop. However I can't confirm we can do all or any of these by next month
 
[list]
[*]Improved AI behaviour
[*]Improved Spawn System for NPC's and Vehicles
[*]Improved Pathfinding
[*]New save data system
[/list]
 
Additionally the new path finding point above leads us to a another heavily requested feature. But of course, we need just a bit more time to experiment... that is:
 
[list]
[*]AI Partner
[/list]
 
We have more in store for Enforcer. But I hope you all will enjoy this update when it launches next month.
 
All the best,
Chris

notes.title: Community Translations
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We do get a lot of offers from the community to help translate this and many others into their language. With this we wanted to launch a community translation pack that will allow you to send us your translations for your language which we can then implement into the game.

If you're interested in translating Enforcer into your own language, you can download the localisation files and find out more info by visiting this link:

http://www.excalibur-publishing.com/pages/community-translations

We of course appreciate all the help we receive and may be able to offer some rewards for some of our translaters that could include being put onto the credits of Enforcer.

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.4.2 NOW LIVE
notes.content:
Today we are launching a new update for Enforcer which includes a selection of fixes and a new police vehicle. We have made the vehicle active straight away, meaning that you don’t have to enter a code in order to unlock it.

Additions
- New Police Vehicle

Fixes
- Key Binding – Fixed an issue where players would not be able to open doors if they changed the key binding
- Truck – Fixed an issue where an arrested civilian would not sit correctly inside the vehicle.

We still have more planned for Enforcer. We are very busy and I hope to share more news very soon

notes.title: Update 1.0.4.1 Now Live
notes.content:
A new update for Enforcer is now live. We have added the following:

-       Vehicles will pull over when using only the siren lights – Players wanted to switch on their lights to pull over drivers, so we are adding this
-      The Light bar colours will be fixed
-       Eating will correctly restore hunger
-	When on duty, you no longer can do house activities
- 	Many other minor fixes

We were hoping to release more mission variations for each map as part of this update, however we need just a little while longer to test this and add upon this. We have however brought forward a new police vehicle. So please enter the following code in the options menu to unlock this new vehicle:

Mytruck

We hope that you are enjoying the game and we have more updates soon.

All the best

notes.title: Incoming Updates - January 27th
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

First I’d like to welcome the new users who have joined us in the past couple of weeks, I hope that you are all doing Mountain Valley PD proud!

Now, I have a few things to announce that we are working on over the next couple of months. We will issue perhaps two batches of updates in that time. So I’d like to detail these that will arrive in the next couple of months.

Update Batch 1
-	More mission variations for each map - This will also mean that crimes will happen in different areas.
-	Vehicles will pull over when using only the siren lights – Players wanted to switch on their lights to pull over drivers, so we are adding this
-	The Light bar colours will be fixed
-	A selection of bug fixes – these will be detailed when the update has been released

Update Batch 2
-	New playable map
-	One more wearable police outfit
-	A new police vehicle
-	More options when pulling over vehicles (perhaps a mini game suggested by the community)
-	A selection of bug fixes - these will be detailed when the update has been released

We will also be adding Polish language into the game very soon too.

We are hoping to get these updates out in the next couple of months, when we nail down a specific date I will let you all know closer to the time.

All the best!

notes.title: UPDATE NOW LIVE: MOTORCYCLE, FIXES AND CHRISTMAS
notes.content:
[img]http://www.excalibur-publishing.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/bikenews.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

We have some very exciting news today. Our next major update is now live and it is a big one. Firstly we would like to thank everyone for their continued support over the last couple of months. Your comments and suggestions are fantastic and the overall community response has been great. 

Before we go any further, we need to let you know that there are some steps you will need to reproduce to make sure that your old save files work with this update. We are sorry that this has to be done but some changes were made to increase performance and allow users to edit custom_data files much more easily.

Please follow this link for information on transferring your save data to the new folder. http://steamcommunity.com/app/318220/discussions/0/626329187134721584/

Now it’s time for the good stuff. 

First, here's a very short video detailing just some of the new additions to Enforcer:

[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3eLfZcZokTk[/url]

New Features
•	New Vehicle – Enter MYBIKE in the secret codes section
•	New Christmas Items – Enter HOHOHO in the secret codes section (use HOHOHO to remove it)
•	A Donut Store
•	The Ability to change controls / key bindings
•	More Diverse missions
•	NPCs will occasionally have body armour
•	Flashlight attachment available on weapons (press L to use with gun drawn)
•	Can now go on and off duty at home or the Police Station
•	Some NPCs are now “wanted” by the police. Check IDs and keep an eye out for NPCs running from you 
•	Players can now change the length of days through the Customisable configuration files
•	All maps now have mechanics, using the tow feature will always place you at the nearest mechanic
•	A new siren type for all current vehicles
•	A Weapon store where players may purchase new types of weapons
•	Medal system, where you character will receive medals based on their actions
•	Vehicle trunks now open when taking items out
•	Limited controller support (Still in testing and will continue to change)

Fixes
•	Fixed Rain sometimes not triggering weather icon
•	Fixed all windows depending on resolution size 
•	Added more places for the taxi to drop you off
•	Longer shifts as default (players can adjust this in XML files) 
•	NPC waypoint fixes 
•	Players can extend the game clock via the XML files 
•	When moving to far from Speed radars, then will be automatically returned to your car
•	Fixed issue when arresting two people, the option to enter the police station does not work 
•	Fixed issue where players are unable to respawn when dying 
•	Fixed issue where players are unable to receive dispatch calls after the first day. 
•	Fixed issue where textures for some vehicles are missing 
•	Decreased overall file sizes for vehicle textures
•	Fixed issue where car rolls away after turning the engine off. 
•	Vehicles use less fuel (it will also have an editable option in the XML files that players can adjust) 
•	Improved siren lights.

Thank you all again for your ongoing support, we really appreciate the community and all their comments. We will continue to add more features and fix any issues we may find so keep your eyes peeled and your engines running for further news and updates.

•	Fixed issue where car rolls away after turning the engine off. 
•	Vehicles use less fuel (it will also have an editable option in the XML files that players can adjust) 
•	Improved siren lights.

Thank you all again for your ongoing support, we really appreciate the community and all their comments. We will continue to add more features and fix any issues we may find so keep your eyes peeled and your engines running for further news and updates.

Thanks for your ongoing support, we really appreciate all of the reviews you guys have given the game and we are always listening to every single piece of feedback. We really would love to continue adding more content so if things continue as they have been it will allow us to really expand the game further with your suggestions.

notes.title: MAC Version Now Available. Bug Fixes List Updated
notes.content:
We are pleased to release Enforcer – Police Crime Action for the MAC. Over the past week we've had a phenomenal amount of support and have worked hard to eliminate some bugs and eve add a few new features including support to mod the textures of the vehicles.

Look below for the full Bug fixes list:
 
Update 1.0. 2 .1
- Image effects changed to support more PC configurations
- Added mouse sensitivity adjustment (Currently the slider controls on foot and in car sensitivity. another slider is being added soon so you can adjust these individually)
- Added volume sliders for sound effects and music
- Player will no longer keep dying when restarting the game (After dying from hunger)
- Player will now longer have energy below 20 after restarting the game
- New system for graphics options (all image effects will be disabled as standard, Players will need to activate effects)
- Reduced Blur
- Shower bug where camera is lost
- Player can replenish stress control after going out with relatives or friends
- Changed the way we have handled the aiming system.(For example, hitting roof instead of the centre of the screen)

Update 1.0.2.2
FIXES
- General: Mouse buttons now activate indicator lights
- General: Center map TOTALLY redone. We hope this will fix the first start game crash (out of memory)
- General: balanced stats without players changing XML custom file (although, we cannot please everyone, you can adjust your game experience by editing the custom XML file)
- General: game is less demanding for shaders and overall textures
- Vehicle: better driving experience (better handling) - we will keep improving with the community feedback.
- Vehicle: vehicle icon fixed (will not appear together with player icon)
- Mission: report does not fit on screen sometimes (Police Station) also players can now use Enter as key to confirm
- Mission: drunks will no longer be reported as an innocent person
- Mission: red markers now will appear more time, but the player will have to check some false players also, giving more challenge, but always a chance to complete
- Player: fixed shot hit markers, so sometimes players cannot hit criminals.
- Player: while on melee combat, will not break animations anymore
- Player: kicking a door in a house with 2 doors no longer crash
- Criminals: made criminals run less than player
- Criminals: will run for more time when evading police
- Camera: fixed orbit cam handle
 
NEW FEATURES
 
- General: made 2 sensitivity sliders (on foot and vehicle)
- General: map select before going out of home
- Camera orbit mode can be activated with the V key
- Vehicle: new sirens for the unmarked vehicle
- Mission: new markers will follow criminals and update from time to time, but it is per zone, not really per criminal
 
Update 1.0.2.3
- Fixed email width and height
- No more flying cars!
- No more use of some batching, this caused troubles for some users
- The player can now only use the police vehicle while on duty
- Fixed texture for wheel type 2
- The screaming woman has been silenced…
- When players by a new civilian vehicle, it no longer spawns in the wrong place
- Vehicle 2 and Vehicle 3 (Charger and SUV) can now have their textures modified

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2.2 NOW LIVE
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Update 1.0.2.2 is now live, if you’ve enabled automatic downloading Steam should update your game. If you come across any issues, please get in touch with us at support@excalibur-publishing.com

Below are a list of fixes and additions to the game.

FIXES
- General: Made mouse buttons activate indicator lights
- General: Center map TOTALLY redone. We hope this will fix the first start game crash (out of memory)
- General: traffic spawn is improved (we will keep improving), I’m afraid there are no more radically futuristic advancements to automobile technology (no more crazy flying cars, but if you spot any, let us know!) (We know there are still some flying cars, we are on top of the issue again!)
- General: balanced stats without players changing XML custom file (although, we cannot please everyone, so, for you that want a different stats, you can change at the custom XML file)
- General: game is less heavy for shaders and overall textures
- Vehicle: better driving experience (better handling) - we will keep improving with the community feedback.
- Vehicle: vehicle icon fixed (will not appear together with player icon)
- Mission: report does not fit on screen sometimes (Police Station) also can use Enter as key to confirm
- Mission: drunks will no longer be reported as an innocent person
- Mission: red markers now will appear more time, but the player will have to check some false players also, giving more challenge, but always a chance to complete
- Player: fixed where shot can hit markers, so sometimes players cannot hit criminals.
- Player: while on mellee combat, will not break animations anymore
- Player: kicking a door in a house with 2 doors no longer crash
- Criminals: make criminals run less than player
- Criminals: will run for more time when running from police
- Camera: fixed orbit cam handle

NEW FEATURES

- General: made 2 sensitivity sliders (on foot and vehicle)
- General: map select before going out of home
- Camera orbit mode works with V key
- Vehicle: new sirens for the unmarked vehicle
- Mission: new markers will follow criminals and update from time to time, but it is per zone, not really per criminal
- Mod: external textures for vehicle modding (players can change and it will be replaced in game). For now, only for the first police vehicle
Thank you for your support, we are still working on the game. Today one of the team is going to be using some player’s custom data and we may add these suggestions into a later update if they work well.

All the best,
Chris

Edit: We are aware of the flying cars issue that still persists! We're on top of this again!

Chris
